title: Slack Bot token: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic Slack Bot token values built to the documented format appear in 3 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Source-backed lexical shape in an explicit context test; repeated shapes are not independent provider coverage.
